name: TX-37
label: Safe D

key_factors: Casar's overwhelming fundraising and cash advantage
Prediction markets price a Democratic win at 98%
model.rationale: Austin-based TX-37 leans Democratic by roughly 30 points, and Casar holds a massive financial edge over a challenger with under $1,000 on hand. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy incumbent win, so the forecast stays near the baseline.
model.watch: Any surprise polling showing a competitive race, or major outside spending against Casar, would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Casar seeks a third term representing this Austin-area district, which leans Democratic by about 30 points. He has raised over $1.1 million and holds nearly $600,000 on hand, while Republican Lauren Peña has raised about $118,000 with almost nothing banked and no visible outside support. No independent polls of the race are available, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive.

Prediction markets price a Casar win at 98%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. The forecast calls this race Safe Democratic, with Casar expected to win by roughly 29 points. The main uncertainty is simply the absence of polling, which widens the error band slightly but does not change the expected outcome.
